definitions.explanation: The second of two things or people mentioned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前者|ぜんしゃ}→前者：03312_zensha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{後者|こうしゃ}
⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後者|こうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。

A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{考|かんが}えると→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧{後者|こうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現実的|げんじつてき}→現実的：04794_genjitsuteki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: There are two proposals, A and B, but considering cost, the latter is more realistic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}→重視：03341_juushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}かれ→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、{後者|こうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: When asked which I value more, speed or safety, I answered that the latter is more important.

notes:
{後者|こうしゃ} means "the latter" when referring to the second of two items previously mentioned.

REGISTER:
Formal/written style. More common in academic writing, business documents, and formal speech.

COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{前者|ぜんしゃ}→前者：03312_zensha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜、{後者|こうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜 (The former is ~, the latter is ~)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {後者|こうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: the latter is more...
- {後者|こうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose the latter
- {後者|こうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧: in the case of the latter

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{前者|ぜんしゃ}→前者：03312_zensha⟧ (the former, the first one)

USAGE:
Only used when exactly two items are being compared. For more than two items, use ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ordinal numbers.
